context: Hello.
Hi there
What kind of movies do you like?
Adventure, romance, nothing with a diff language I have a hard time understanding
I would recommend any of the Marvel superhero movies for adventure.
I like Marvel, actually just watched the Joker last night
Joaquin Phoenix is great in that.
Yes, alot of mixed reviews from other people. But I really enjoyed it.
Would you want to watch a trailer for Captain Marvel?
Sure, I can watch a trailer
This movie came out last year and is one of the more recent Marvel movies.
Okay, I personally have no watched it yet, but I believe my son has.
It's got a good cast and female lead.
Brie Larson is a good actress and she keeps you watching. Really easy to get into her story role.
Also Samuel L. Jackson is one of my favorite actors.
I could listen to Samuel L Jackson talk all day. I love everything he stars in.
The storyline looks really interesting too.
The graphics in the movie look amazing. They chose great actors for this movie for sure.
Agreed on the graphics. They really push the boundaries of what Hollywood is capable of.
We love Marvel here in this house, it seems like they keep you on your toes through the whole movie. It would be great to watch in 3D.
Yes these are great movies to watch in 3D.
Alot of people called it a flop, but I am willing to disagree on that opinion.
Me too. I hope you enjoy the trailer and the movie!
Thank you for the recommendation
